# E0309: record that contains itself

Building such a record would need one already built, forever. Make the field optional, as `next: Option<Node>`, or a list.

- Rule: [`declarations.recursive-types`](../../reference/10-declarations.md#declarations.recursive-types)
- Reported at: the name of the last record of the group that contains itself (errors.several-places).
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0309:1
type Node = { value: i64, next: Node }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
type Node = { value: i64, next: Option<Node> }
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0309_record_that_contains_itself.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0309_record_that_contains_itself.lt):

```text
── RECORD THAT CONTAINS ITSELF ── E0309_record_that_contains_itself.lt:1:6  [E0309]

This record contains itself, so no value of it can be built:

  1 │ type Loop = { next: Loop }
    │      ^^^^

Building such a record would need one already built, forever. Make the field
optional, as `next: Option<Node>`, or a list.
```
